title: [codex] Conditional κ = 0.00330420 (+6.60e-6 over #6702)
body:
This changes the complete P104 caller and claims **conditional κ = 0.00330420**, an increase of **0.00000660 (+0.20015%) over #6702's 0.00329760**, under the same five framework assumptions. The native word is inherited byte-for-byte from #6702 at `edd6a37a9ff87b254fb7466184348d1432d0c8c0`. This is a candidate for scientific review; no selected-frontier file changes or independent admission are implied.

The new exact eight-field/nine-query root has five full-stage ranks `(2,4,4,3,2)`. Its adjacent rank-four stages share an actual two-coordinate idle bank and a common active basis, so both idle payloads receive one combined B+C job each. A new ordinary two-sided dual pair at cut353 then permits a genuinely independent continuation input. The final word has 35 arbitrary main inputs, 586 instructions, 18 unchanged native invocations and 17 thin queries.

For `H(r)=r^t`, the **complete signed gain** over #6702 is

```text
104*(H1+H16-H17) + 208*((H41-H40)-(H57-H56)) > 0,  0<t<1.
```

There is one literal fresh-input retirement (`H33 -> H1+H32`). “Second-retirement-equivalent” describes the complete invoice comparison, not a second free operation. Fusion alone only reconstructs the preceding best tariff; the new cut proof is essential. The complete invoice has 13,774 productive fields, 66,956 paid calls and unchanged rank-mass surplus760. The raw crossing is enclosed in `(0.0033042804235,0.0033042804236)`, which is also the stated fixed-invoice ceiling.

Validation completed locally with Python3.12 and the standard library:

- Full unchanged source reconstruction and exact saved receipts, 800 native columns/640,000 coefficient positions, owned lifetimes and absolute native phases.
- Both complete caller engines over all 1,225 input/output coefficient positions, exact common-idle bases and direct two-sided fresh-input identities.
- All 7,488 new physical main contacts, every target/idle phase, complete formula/event invoices and all semantic failure controls.
- Two rational moment engines, a freshly funded 11/12 completion (old12/13 is rejected), explicit uniform compiler and all54+4 outer predicates.
- Fresh scalar/route/storage constants, including coefficient37 and all110 lambda normalizations; ordinary upper bound252,020,208 < 10^9.
- Full normal and optimized-mode replays passed (105.73s/108.31s). A separately written standard-library logical verifier also passed normal/-O; all checks are author-side, not external review.

The [registered upstream workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41879594058) passed both full normal/optimized replays, both independent logical checks, and the committed-input cleanliness guard on this exact head. A separate Git-free export of all 45 committed package files also passed the full read-only replay (87.63s). CI success is reproducibility evidence; scientific admission remains pending.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-common-idle-double-retirement
```

The package includes PROOF.md, complete constructors/words, source pins, offline retained source, independent verifier, rational receipt and validation logs. Review the actual common-idle bank and cut353 identities first, then the full registered replay. The inherited `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape` and `analytic_recovery` assumptions remain explicit; no unconditional multiplication theorem or practical benchmark is claimed.

New root/common-idle/cut/invoice application: thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and parallel agents. All original notices and frozen source bytes are preserved.
